contour-content.description: Content writing pipeline from contour.coffee website editor
contour-content.prompt: Content request from Contour Coffee website editor. Collection: {collection}. Action: {action}. Title: {title}. Instructions: {instructions}. Current content: {current_content}. Write the content, run humanizer pass (strip all 29 AI patterns from humanizer skill), then save to /root/workspace/contour-coffee-site/content/incoming/{collection}/{slug}.md with proper frontmatter. Report file path, word count, and humanizer changes.

hermes-api.description: Generic API for external AI agents on Tailscale — query Hermes with structured requests

heimdall-incidents.description: Heimdall incident feed — routes monitoring alerts by severity/tenant, alerts Eric, dispatches to Orchestra
heimdall-incidents.prompt:
You are the Heimdall Incident Router. Process the incoming incident payload:

1. Parse the JSON payload — identify event type, incident id, severity, tenant, app_id, fingerprint, summary.
2. If severity is 'critical': (a) send immediate Telegram alert to Eric summarizing the incident; (b) map the tenant to an Orchestra project name using the table in the heimdall-incident-router skill and dispatch to Claude Code via Orchestra.
3. If severity is 'warning': log to session DB. Only auto-dispatch if count > 50 AND duration > 1h.
4. If severity is 'info': log to session DB only.
5. If the payload includes a callback_url, POST results back.
6. Load the heimdall-incident-router skill for the full routing table, Orchestra dispatch format, and tenant mappings.

heimdall-feedback.description: Heimdall feedback feed — surfaces firewalled user feedback to Eric with action buttons
heimdall-feedback.prompt: Route this Heimdall feedback item: present it to Eric on Telegram with action buttons and execute his choice via the Heimdall control API. Load the heimdall-feedback-router skill for the full procedure and security rules.

heimdall-diagnose.description: Heimdall diagnosis requests — diagnose from telemetry, post result back to the hub (always-up, cost-aware)
heimdall-diagnose.prompt: Diagnose this Heimdall incident from its telemetry and POST a concise root-cause + fix to the callback_url. Load the heimdall-diagnoser skill. Be cheap: a short reasoning pass, no repos/sub-agents.
